root.name: Bishop's Opening: Vienna Hybrid
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nf6 3. d3 Nc6 4. Nc3

overview: A Vienna and Bishop's Opening hybrid that reaches an Italian-type position with d3 and Nc3. White develops Bc4, Nc3, Nf3 and later f4 or O-O, keeping options. Black mirrors with ...Bc5 or ...Bb4 and ...d6, and the game is a slow manoeuvring fight.

white_ideas.idea: Nf3, O-O and Bg5 pin ideas, sometimes f4 with a kingside plan
Keep the bishop aimed at f7 and play on the centre with Na4 or Nd5

black_ideas.idea: ...Bb4 pins and ...Na5 trade of the bishop

typical_structures.structure: Giuoco Pianissimo-style e4/d3 against e5/d6, centre in tension

level.notes: Pianissimo is a Beginner anchor; same scheme here.

character.reason: Quiet Italian-style play, hard to lose quickly.

structure.reason: e4/e5 centre with d3, like the Pianissimo.

level.reason: Clear plans and little to memorise, like the Pianissimo.
